responsibility: Defines the RAII-style builder API used to construct and emit rustc diagnostics from a `DiagCtxt`. This file provides the `IntoDiagnostic` conversion trait, the generic `DiagnosticBuilder` wrapper around a `Diagnostic`, the emission-guarantee mechanism that ties particular diagnostic levels to their post-emit result types or abort behavior, forwarding methods for decorating diagnostics with spans/notes/help/suggestions, and the drop-time safeguard that reports diagnostics that were built but never emitted or cancelled.
